scope: Manual native Safari acceptance against a real Cognito user pool and a private HTTPS loopback ATLAS server. Fictional RFP data and local SQLite. Human performed password entry and certificate-warning decision.
source_identity_limit: On-disk fingerprints of the relevant implementation; not a signed execution attestation.
limits: Thirteen manual observations, not thirteen automated tests or a general reliability estimate.
The real flow used the application’s pinned token verifier; raw cookies, tokens and identity records were not exported.
One real identity and local SQLite; no durable managed-service hosting, reverse proxy or multi-instance session acceptance.
Real provider outage, token tampering, callback replay, membership revocation, expiry and CSRF attacks were not repeated in this run; their existing controlled checks have separate reports.
Sign-out ends the application session; the provider SSO session may remain active, as confirmed by repeat sign-in.
Page reload requires explicit workspace reconnection and analysis selection; review persistence does not imply automatic UI state restoration.
The synthetic review tests persistence and authorization, not legal compliance or model quality.
Private configuration, database, browser images, user identity and provider identifiers remain excluded from public source.
